Dish: GF Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Bars
Instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Place bars on a baking sheet, cover with foil, and warm for 8-10 minutes. Best enjoyed slightly warm. Served by the dozen.

Instructions: Serve at room temperature — no reheating needed, or warm in oven at 300°F for 5 minutes. Served by the dozen.

Dish: Lamb Kofta with Garlic Sauce, Tomatoes, Shredded Lettuce & Pita Bread
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place kofta on a baking sheet, cover loosely with foil, and bake for 10-12 minutes until heated through. Warm pita wrapped in foil alongside. Serve garlic sauce, tomatoes, and lettuce cold. Serve with peas and carrots on the side.

Preheat oven to 350°F. Place enchiladas in an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 20-25 minutes until heated through and bubbling. Remove foil for the last 5 minutes to re-melt the cheese. Serve with peas and carrots on the side.

Dish: Greek Salmon Bowl over Basmati Rice
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place salmon on a baking sheet, cover with foil, and bake for 10-12 minutes until warmed through. Serve over basmati rice at room temperature, top with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, Kalamata olives, and greens cold, and serve tzatziki on the side.

Dish: Braised Pork over Mashed Potatoes with Sauerkraut & Apples
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place pork and sauce in an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 20-25 minutes until heated through. Warm mashed potatoes in a separate covered dish alongside.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Place chicken and sofrito rice in an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 18-20 minutes until heated through.

Dish: Mediterranean Baked White Fish over Greek Lemon Rice & Grilled Asparagus
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place fish in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 10-12 minutes until warmed through. Warm rice and asparagus in a separate covered dish alongside.

Dish: Filet Mignon, Roasted Baby Potatoes & Garlicky Green Beans
Instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F. Place filet on a baking sheet, cover with foil, and warm for 12-15 minutes — low and slow preserves the texture. Warm potatoes and green beans on a separate baking sheet uncovered at 400°F for 10-12 minutes.

Dish: Thai Inspired Peanut Coconut Cauliflower Chickpea Curry over Coconut Rice
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place curry in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 18-20 minutes until heated through, stirring once halfway. Warm coconut rice in a separate covered dish alongside.
